WITH race_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    r.name,
    SUM(res.points) as total_points
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
global_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_points) as avg_total_points
  FROM race_totals
),
above_avg_races AS (
  SELECT rt.name, rt.total_points
  FROM race_totals rt
  WHERE rt.total_points > (SELECT avg_total_points FROM global_avg)
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT SUM(total_points) FROM above_avg_races) as combined_total_points,
  (SELECT AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) 
   FROM results res
   JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
   WHERE r.name IN (SELECT name FROM above_avg_races)) as average_laps_completed,
  (SELECT AVG(aar.total_points - (SELECT avg_total_points FROM global_avg))
   FROM above_avg_races aar) as average_excess
